### Label

SYCE1-related gametogenic failure

### Synonyms

_No response_

### Synonym type

None

### Definition

Individuals with variants in SYCE1 may present with varying phenotypes. 46XY individuals can present with non-obstructive azoospermia due to maturation arrest/meiotic failure. 46XX individuals can present with primary ovarian insufficiency (POI). 

### Parent term

New term has the same parents as MONDO:0014844 premature ovarian failure 12 and MONDO:0014847 spermatogenic failure 15
